new-resume.title: How do I create a new resume?
new-resume.step1: Click “New Resume” on the welcome page or in the Resume section on the left.
new-resume.step2: Choose “New blank resume” and pick a template — you can set it as the default while you're at it.
new-resume.step3: Enter the editor and start with the Basics section.
new-resume.hint: Once you see the module cards appear in the editor, your resume is ready.

import-resume.title: How do I import an existing resume (PDF/Word)?
import-resume.step2: Pick a PDF or Word file and fields are recognized automatically (smart recognition if AI is configured, rule-based fallback otherwise). The Resume manager page also offers batch import — multiple files become separate resumes right away, with no review steps.
import-resume.step3: Nothing is written until you confirm each item in the three-step review wizard.
import-resume.hint: After all three review steps are confirmed, your resume opens in the editor.

template-color.title: How do I change templates and colors?
template-color.step1: Open “Settings → Template Settings” to preview all three templates and adjust font size, spacing and more.
template-color.step2: Switch the current resume's theme color right from the editor top bar; the default template for new resumes is chosen under “Settings → Template Settings”.
template-color.hint: Previews update live, and saved settings apply to later exports.

ai-usage.title: How do the AI features work, and what do I need?
ai-usage.step1: AI is bring-your-own-key: enter your own API key under “Settings → AI Settings”; it is encrypted and stored on this device only.
ai-usage.step2: Four tools are included: grammar correction, self-introduction drafting with English translation, polishing, and job match scoring.
ai-usage.step3: Every AI result is written into your resume only after you confirm it.
ai-usage.hint: Once your key is set up, all four tools become available in the AI section.

export-pdf.title: How do I export a PDF?
export-pdf.step1: Open a resume to enter the editor.
export-pdf.step2: Click “Export” in the top bar. If you turn on “Privacy mode” (Ctrl+Shift+P) first, sensitive info is exported behind masks.
export-pdf.step3: Exports use the same template as the preview — what you see is what you get.
export-pdf.hint: Once you click Export and the dialog closes on its own, your file has been saved to the chosen folder.

manage-resumes.title: How do I manage multiple resumes?
manage-resumes.step1: Resume manager on the left supports searching, opening and bulk deletion; to rename a resume, edit the “Resume name” field in the editor's top bar.
manage-resumes.step2: Each resume can be linked to a job you're applying for; use the clock icon in its row to view and restore version history.
manage-resumes.hint: The list page covers day-to-day management needs.

data-storage.title: Where is my data stored?
data-storage.step1: All data stays on this device only (by default in a “xiaomengresume” folder under your system Documents directory, customizable) — no account, no uploads.
data-storage.step2: View or move the storage location anytime under “Settings → Storage”.
data-storage.hint: Your data always remains on your own computer.
